labelLayout.method: Each packshot is treated as a cylinder panel (angle = asin of the normalised column). Seam positions and panel spacing are chosen to minimise colour and artwork mismatch at the seams, constrained to close the circle.

flat_badge_fix.item: Wild Caught badge on the front panel
flat_badge_fix.finding: In the official packshot this badge was pasted on flat (not foreshortened by the cylinder), unlike the printed halal and ASME logos which measure 1.00 to 1.04 once unrolled. Unrolling it as if foreshortened made it about 1.41 times too wide when viewed face-on.
flat_badge_fix.fix: Columns inside the badge's rows are remapped so its arc width equals its height. Only sampling positions change; no pixel is redrawn. The angle freed is absorbed in the plain background to its left, and the front panel ends just after the badge.
flat_badge_fix.note: Rendered values come from orthographic face-on renders of the GLB; the Australia figures use a colour mask, the others a visual pixel check.
